{{Attr|Nimble}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Withered''' is a fast [[Enemies|enemy]] that appears in [[Badlands II]]. It has decent health, though lower than some other enemies that debuted before it, like the [[Giant Skeleton]]. It does, however, have a very fast speed, being the fastest enemy that has debuted by this point, and it has a decent amount of defense. ==Appearance== The '''Withered''' is an entity with most of its dark grey skeleton exposed. It has dark grey claws on its hands and feet, torso with fur around its neck and a grey skull with neon orange eyes and antlers. It also has two additional arms on its back. When it is killed, it falls over causing its head to fall off. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers like the [[Pursuit]], [[Engineer]], [[Ranger]], [[Golden Minigunner]] or [[Accelerator]] can be useful against this. **The [[Commander]] or [[DJ Booth]] can be used to boost the statistics of your towers. *As the '''Withered''' is a quite fast enemy, especially when [[Nimble]], and it has no immunities against stalling, freezing or stunning towers like the [[Electroshocker]] or [[Freezer]] can be very effective at stalling it. **Multiple of such towers and some non-stalling towers like the [[Pyromancer]] can also be used to reduce its defense, allowing you to deal more damage to it. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} WitheredStun.gif|Current stun animation (5 February 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1Withered.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseWithered.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Tower Defense Simulator Roblox Trailer|'''Withered''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} WitheredIconIG.png|'''Withered''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Withered''' resembles a modern depiction of the [[wp:Wendigo|Wendigo]], a monster from [[wp:Algonquian peoples|Native Algonquian]] Folklore. ==Update History== *'''5 Feburary 2025''' - [[v1.52.0]] **'''Withered''' added. {{Badlands|[[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]]|Wave 16|Withered|Wave 18|[[Undead Miner]]|Wave 20}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Mid-Game]]
